name: Konoe Akira
source:
A young man on a ship bound for the Far East. Even though he is a university student, in the Far East he is known as the "Pianist of the Piano" and actively participates in performances and media appearances.

He's a descendant of the Konoe family, one of the "Five Emperors" that once ruled the Far East. Each time Yuni meets him, he gets confused by how his impression always seems different.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#konoe]official website[/url]]
